The Maxxus 2-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Sauna featuring PureTech™ Near Zero EMF infrared technology. The full-spectrum heating system delivers near, mid, and far infrared heat.

Crafted from natural reforested Canadian Red Cedar, this sauna not only offers durability and excellent heat retention but also enhances relaxation with its soothing natural aroma. The compact 2-person design makes it a perfect addition to any home wellness space, gym, or spa retreat.

Maxxus 2-Person Infrared Sauna – The Ultimate Home Wellness Investment

This Maxxus 2-Person Near Zero EMF Infrared Sauna is built to provide a high-quality, space-efficient, and luxurious sauna experience. With six strategically placed heating elements, including four FAR infrared panels and two near-infrared elements.

Why Choose the Maxxus 2-Person Near Zero EMF Infrared Sauna?

  • Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF Heating Technology – 6 strategically placed heating panels, including PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR infrared panels and near-infrared elements for comprehensive heat therapy.
  • Space-Saving 2-Person Design – Perfectly sized for home wellness rooms, gyms, and relaxation spaces, offering a cozy yet comfortable sauna experience.
  • Luxury Wellness Features – Oversized chromotherapy lighting system, red light therapy, and exterior accent lighting create a calming atmosphere.
  • Smart Controls & Audio System – Includes 2024 model interior touchscreen control panel, Bluetooth connectivity, MP3 auxiliary input, FM radio, and built-in speakers.
  • Premium Materials & Craftsmanship – Constructed from 100% natural reforested Canadian Red Cedar, ensuring durability, superior heat retention, and an aesthetically pleasing finish.

Key Features of the Maxxus 2-Person Infrared Sauna

1. Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Heating System

This sauna is equipped with six advanced infrared heating panels, positioned for maximum coverage and efficiency. The heating panel layout includes:

  • Four FAR infrared carbon panels
  • Two near-infrared heating elements

2. Chromotherapy & Red Light Therapy for Maximum Relaxation

The Maxxus infrared sauna features an advanced chromotherapy lighting system, which utilizes different color wavelengths.

3. Premium Canadian Red Cedar Construction

Made from 100% sustainably sourced Canadian Red Cedar, this sauna is naturally durable, resistant to moisture, and provides a calming aromatic experience. The bronze-tinted tempered glass door and side windows offer a sleek, modern aesthetic while maintaining privacy.

4. Smart Touchscreen Control Panel & Bluetooth Audio System

The sauna includes an interior touchscreen control panel, allowing users to easily adjust temperature and lighting settings. The built-in Bluetooth speakers, MP3 auxiliary input, and FM radio.

Looking for a Larger Infrared Sauna?

If you need a larger sauna with similar features, check out our Maxxus 3-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna for more space and comfort.

Specifications & Electrical Requirements

  • Capacity: 2-Person
  • Exterior Dimensions: 75” H x 50” W x 47” D
  • Heating System: 6 Total Heaters
    • 4 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR Infrared Carbon Panels
    • 2 Near Infrared Heating Elements
  • Glass Type: Bronze-Tinted Tempered Glass Door with Side Windows
  • Control System: Interior Touchscreen Control Panel (2024 Model, No Exterior Panel)
  • Lighting System: Chromotherapy Lighting + Red Light Therapy + Exterior Accent Lighting
  • Audio System: Bluetooth, MP3 Auxiliary, Built-in Speakers, FM Radio
  • Temperature Range: 118°F - 132°F (Maximum 140°F)
  • Electrical Requirements: 120V, 15A Non-GFCI Plug & Play (Recommend Dedicated Outlet)
